approval_requests_decision_is_complete.name: approval_requests_decision_is_complete
approval_requests_decision_is_complete.value:
("approvals"."approval_requests"."status" = 'pending' and "approvals"."approval_requests"."decided_by" is null and "approvals"."approval_requests"."decided_at" is null)
          or ("approvals"."approval_requests"."status" = 'cancelled' and "approvals"."approval_requests"."decided_by" is null)
          or ("approvals"."approval_requests"."status"::text = 'auto_approved' and "approvals"."approval_requests"."decided_by" is null and "approvals"."approval_requests"."decided_at" is not null)
          or ("approvals"."approval_requests"."status" in ('approved', 'rejected') and "approvals"."approval_requests"."decided_by" is not null and "approvals"."approval_requests"."decided_at" is not null)

periods_whole_month.name: periods_whole_month
periods_whole_month.value:
extract(day from "ledger"."periods"."starts_on") = 1
          and "ledger"."periods"."ends_on" = ("ledger"."periods"."starts_on" + interval '1 month' - interval '1 day')::date

periods_closed_has_closer.name: periods_closed_has_closer
periods_closed_has_closer.value: "ledger"."periods"."status" <> 'closed' or ("ledger"."periods"."closed_at" is not null and "ledger"."periods"."closed_by" is not null)
